# **Re: Filing of Motor Long Term Third Party Insurance /Long Term Package Covers /Bundled Products under the File and Use Guidelines** 

The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India ('The Authority'), in terms of Circular ref: IRDAI/NL/CIR/MOT/137/08/2018 dated 28<sup>th</sup> August, 2018, had assigned Unique Identification Number (UIN) to Motor Long Term Third Party Insurance, Long Term Package Covers and Bundled Products based on the Letter of Intent filed by General Insurers to enable them to offer these covers effective 1<sup>st</sup> September, 2018. As per para 5(ii) and (iv) of the said Circular, the Insurers were required to file all such Products/Add-ens under the File and Use Guidelines before 15<sup>th</sup> September, 2018. 

The Authority has been receiving representations from the General Insurers, requesting for extension of time to file the said Products/Add-ens, citing various reasons including technical issues encountered in electronic filing in BAP. 

Having regard to the concerns expressed by the Insurers, the Authority, in terms of Section 14(2) of I RDA Act 1999 hereby extends the last date of filing to 15<sup>th</sup> October, 2018. 

All other contents of Circular dated 28<sup>th</sup> August, 2018 shall remain in effect. 

( . **. Joseph) Member (Non-life)**
